strategies.name: 5m option Buy: bollinger band entry and trail
strategies.description: Manual NIFTY strategy (disabled during scanner mode). Bollinger Band strategy with trailing stop loss. Operates on 5-minute timeframe with 20-period bands and 2.0 standard deviation.

experimental._comment: Profitability Recovery Plan — May 15, 2026. Flip any flag to revert behavior without code change.
experimental._phase2_comment: Pullback entry state machine. ACTIVE on Slots 2+3 (A/B vs Slot 1 immediate control). To roll out fully: pullbackSlots=[0,1,2]. To revert: enablePullbackEntry=false.
Pullback entry state machine. Slot 2 only (slot 1 immediate, slot 3 FVG — see Phase 3). Revert: enablePullbackEntry=false.
experimental._pullback_window_comment: Jun 4 2026: bumped from 4→8 after live data showed TITAN ARM pullback fired at candle 8 (13:50, RSI 51) — 4-candle window abandoned 4 candles too early. 8 candles = 40min ARM window.
experimental._phase3_comment: FVG retrace entry on slot 3 only. A/B against slot 1 (immediate) and slot 2 (RSI pullback). Strict invalidation — close below FVG floor cancels and frees slot.
experimental._phase3_lookback_comment: Jun 2026: BOSCH 2026-06-09 retest of breakout-impulse FVG was missed because c2.timestamp >= armTs filter excluded the signal-impulse FVG itself. Lookback scans the most recent fvgLookbackCandles 3-candle windows at ARM (c3 ≤ signal) for an untouched bullish FVG; first surviving zone is loaded directly into the watch and proceeds to trigger/ratchet logic on the next candle.
experimental._phase3_upgrade_comment: Jun 17 2026: HAL retraced into a BIGGER FVG formed by the signal-impulse candle (completes one candle after arm), but the watch had locked a marginal earlier gap and never re-scanned. Upgrade tracks the freshest valid FVG (newer impulse) while pre-trigger only, so the signal-impulse gap supersedes. Stops upgrading once a trigger is set. Slot-3 only (rides existing FVG slot gating).
experimental._imp001_comment: IMP-001: stateful scanner candles (seed once, append from quotes). Engine + persistence + poll loop wired. Robust fallback to full re-fetch if the store can't be made fresh. Validate via GET /api/scanner/candle-engine. Set false to revert to legacy full re-fetch every scan.
experimental._vwap_comment: Finding #2: session-anchored intraday VWAP (resets at 09:15) vs legacy multi-day cumulative. OFF = legacy. Flip to A/B — changes the trend score (spot>vwap) and therefore stock selection. Validate by diffing 'Top 10 Scored Stocks' trend (T:) component OFF vs ON before trusting live.
experimental._liquidity_comment: Phase 2 fix Jun 2026 — executor liquidity gate now matches scanner: accept if (oi >= multiplier*lot_size) OR (vol >= minVolFallback). Was hardcoded oi>=10000 which rejected scanner-picked NIFTY 100 stocks like BOSCHLTD.
